at_m0.outcome: observed hazard violation OR observation-domain exit; unresolved futures censored

at_matched.outcome: observed hazard violation OR observation-domain exit; unresolved futures censored

contact_measurement.legacy_interpretation: Untyped n_contacts counts any collision, including walls; it cannot identify pusher-T contact or free motion

protocol.horizon: root through K action blocks, inclusive; K starts at 1
protocol.truth: observed clearance <= 0 OR observed pusher-domain exit; unknown suffix is censored
protocol.acceptance: predicted cumulative clearance >= margin, including equality

source_availability.endpoint: both true endpoints of each interpolated prefix block observed
source_availability.real_readout: both endpoints of every interpolated prefix block observed and image-valid; no earlier domain exit
source_availability.imagined: valid observed root image; actual future need not remain observed or in-domain

protocol.pose_errors: Endpoint error at K, scored only against an observed, image-valid target with no earlier observed domain exit; one contribution per physical branch, never per layout
protocol.clearance_errors: Predicted prefix minimum minus dense prefix minimum; only complete, image-valid true prefixes and available sources; positive is optimistic
protocol.regimes: Contact and rotation use this prefix only. No observed contact in an incomplete prefix is unknown, not free motion. Boundary-distance strata require complete dense truth.
protocol.layout_strata: A physical branch may occur in both near/far strata under different layouts, once per stratum for pose errors
protocol.compatibility: Supplementary diagnostics only; legacy full-horizon rows, metrics and development gate are unchanged
